# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

**Best ANC for the money: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS ranks it #1 under $200. Its noise cancelling competes with Sony and Bose flagships, with 60 hours of battery, multipoint, and LDAC.
- Downsides: high clamping force and thin headband padding, so it may be uncomfortable on larger heads.
- RTINGS says it only "sometimes" goes on sale just under $200, so check the current price. [RTINGS page with Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart price links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Soundcore Space Q45 (around $100)**
- RTINGS calls it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested, with about 28 hours of battery and a comfortable fit.
- Downsides: some ANC hiss, and owners report the headband or hinges can crack. [RTINGS page with Amazon and Walmart links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Best battery and deal right now: Soundcore Space One Pro ($199.99)**
- It has 40 hours of battery with ANC on, LDAC, and a fold-flat design. It has no IP rating, and the specs note that LDAC doesn't work with multipoint.
- Tom's Guide lists it as its best under $200.
- Dealectric tested code **AFSC20** in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22 and got $39.99 off, for about **$160**. The code is for full-price items only and expires 2026-12-31. The store's checkout has the final word.
- [Buy at Soundcore's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- The newer Space 2 Pro is also $199.99 with Bluetooth 6.1, but its battery is 30 hours with ANC on. [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one-pro)

**Best sound: Sennheiser ACCENTUM Plus**
- It has smooth, bassy tuning, a parametric EQ, aptX Adaptive, and 56 hours of battery.
- Its ANC is weaker than the Q45's, especially on low rumble like plane engines. [RTINGS under-$200 page with Amazon, Best Buy and B&H links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

**Best all-rounder for calls: Sony ULT WEAR (about $200)**
- RTINGS picks it for calls. SoundGuys measured more than 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz, and it has LDAC and multipoint. Its battery is the shortest here, at about 32 hours. [RatingMobile summary](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Cheapest to try: JLab JBuds Lux ANC (about $80)**
- It has a 44-hour battery and a 10-band EQ. SoundGuys measured the weakest ANC of the group (10–20 dB below 700 Hz), so it only takes the edge off noise. [Same RatingMobile summary](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Another option:** The Sony WH-CH730N has great ANC and comfort but costs about $176–178 in the US. Tom's Guide says that's high for what you get. [Tom's Guide review with Amazon and Best Buy links](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

**My pick:** For the strongest ANC, get the JBL Live 780NC if you find it under $200. For the best deal today, get the Space One Pro at about $160 with the code. On a tight budget, the Q45 is hard to beat.

I can't browse, so prices come from the search results and may have changed. Except for the Soundcore link, the links above go to review pages with retailer price links, not direct checkout pages.
